video.label: Demo of the nullish assistant
video.description: In the nullish app, the assistant is asked three questions about the company's books: how much a client paid this year, what is left on the bank account, and how much VAT is owed for 2026. It answers each one with figures taken from the accounting: the client's paid invoices, the bank balance with money in and out since the start of the year, and the VAT due under the net rate method.

boring.label: the boring part
boring.title: The stuff every accounting app has.

lessBoring.label: the less boring part
lessBoring.title: Then we got a bit carried away.

cards.title: No dashboard. Just ask.
cards.text: “Which invoices are still open?” Ask in the app or from your own AI agent.

cards.title: QR-bills that don’t gossip.
cards.text: Payment references are random, so your clients can’t read how business is going.

cards.title: Hide the numbers.
cards.text: Blur the amounts when someone’s reading over your shoulder.

cards.title: Invoices that look like you.
cards.text: Customize the whole template, not just a logo and a line of text.

cards.title: Crypto? Sure.
cards.text: Every currency gets the decimals it needs, even all 18 of them for Ether.

cards.title: Open source.
cards.text: Audit every line, run it on your own servers, change what you need.
